01

A shortcut that follows you

Ctrl + Q

Hold Control and press your shortcut repeatedly to choose an earlier tab. Release Control to switch. Shift reverses direction; Esc cancels.

按住 Control，多次按快捷键，依次选择更早访问的标签。松开 Control 确认；加 Shift 反向；Esc 取消。

Want Control + Tab?

Chrome reserves that key combination. Use the included macOS key mapping setup to send the extension shortcut instead. In Chrome’s shortcut editor, keep the shortcut set to In Chrome.

原生 Control + Tab 需要配合项目里的 macOS 按键映射配置；扩展自身无法覆盖 Chrome 保留的快捷键。

02

A familiar view, at a glance

Loading…

Keyboard switching and in-page title cards work without enabling screenshot previews. Website previews are optional saved screenshots of tabs you have viewed. They stay on this device, inside the extension. No image or tab history is sent to a server.

预览是你浏览过的页面的缓存截图，只保存在本机扩展内，不上传。启用时 Chrome 会请求网站访问权限，以便自动截取当前页面。

Some browser pages cannot show the overlay; use the toolbar panel there. Tabs without a screenshot show a site initial. Previews are cached snapshots, so they may be older than the live page.

Chrome 内置页等受限页面使用工具栏面板。还没缓存的标签显示站点首字母；预览不是后台实时画面。
